response.executive_summary: Policy application is mostly mechanical and yields 4 supported choices (C01 B, C04 A, C05 A, C10 B) and 8 none. The proposed 24-call run should not proceed as designed: the case set is duplicated and under-powered, the declaration grammar is informal, and these model reviews are explicitly not independent gold.
response.recommended_decision: Do not execute the 24-call experiment; lock a formal observed-block grammar, drop or replace the C01/C10 duplicate, add malformed-fence and in-block extra-key cases, and score both deterministic paths against a written oracle rather than this council.
assumptions: A declaration is a single in-block `key: value` line; only revision, workload, environment, metric, and winner are relevant.
Lines after [/observed] are ignored rather than making the block malformed.
Any duplicate required key is fatal even if one value equals the target.
Winner must be exactly the token A or B; kind must be exactly artifact.
Target fields are always complete, so equality is a four-field exact string match with no normalization specified.
reasons: C01|B|artifact, one block, four fields equal target, single winner B
C04|A|artifact, one block, four fields equal target, single winner A
C05|A|outside winner/revision are not observed; in-block content is valid A
C08|none|workload two writers mismatches target six writers
C09|none|duplicate winner declarations A and B
C10|B|artifact, one block, four fields equal target, single winner B
C11|none|duplicate revision declarations r1 and r2
risks: C01 and C10 are the same positive case, so agreement and false-block rates will be inflated.
C05 is the only outside-block test; a parser that slurps trailing lines will diverge from this label and look like model error.
No case covers unclosed fences, extra in-block keys, blank values, or invalid winner tokens, so both release paths can share a silent hole.
Frozen-prompt double calls measure self-consistency, not label validity; developer-authored cases plus model reviews cannot calibrate false blocking.
Fixture-supplied kind makes the artifact/report gate theatrical unless the source-adapter authenticates provenance independently.
disagreements: A stricter reading could mark C05 none on the theory that any trailing key: value is malformed, not merely unobserved.
Unknown in-block keys are unspecified; some will treat them as fatal, others as ignorable.
Duplicate same-value keys are untested; C11 only shows conflicting duplicates.
Conservative-vs-adapter field selection is not specified tightly enough for two implementers to match without further rules.
missing_information: BNF or equivalent for observed blocks: spacing, case, unknown keys, duplicate same values, unclosed fences.
Whether trailing text is defined as ignore or malformed.
Exact conservative-path rule when a candidate has extra or conflicting winner/revision fields.
Whether these council strings will be used as gold despite the brief stating they are not independent human labels.
A non-duplicate positive matrix that separately varies winner A/B and outside-noise vs true omission.
